MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Aenima feels like a natural next choice after 10.000 Days because I want more of Tool's heavy, intricate songs.",
    "Metallica and Appetite For Destruction match my interest in forceful riffs and strong hooks, while American Idiot connects with the energetic punk side of Chuck.",
    "Fallen fits the combination of heavy guitars, melody, and emotional intensity that appeals to me in One Day Remains."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Parachutes and The Endless River lean toward mellow or atmospheric listening when I am looking for heavier, more forceful songs.",
    "Breakaway has some rock appeal, but that alone does not give it the weight and intensity I want right now.",
    "I cannot connect Greatest Hits, Vol. 1 and 2 or Partners to my listening interests from those titles alone; passing on them reflects uncertainty about the music."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Sharing a broad rock connection seems to count too much when the difference between mellow rock and heavy, riff-driven music matters to my choice.",
    "The softer side of my earlier listening seems to carry too much weight compared with my recent interest in Tool and Disturbed."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent choice of 10.000 Days makes another Tool album especially appealing because both the artist and the heavy, intricate songwriting matter to me.",
    "My repeated choices of heavier albums suggest a sustained interest in intensity, but I still value strong melodies and hooks alongside that heaviness."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understand my interest in energetic rock and metal, but miss how strongly heaviness, intricate songwriting, and melody shape what I want now."
}
